review_findings.summary: Cache source lineage initially accepted syntactically valid but unverified artifact IDs.
review_findings.resolution: Source IDs must now be touched and reverified by the same GenerationPin; empty, duplicate, unknown, changed, or self-referential lineage is rejected.

review_findings.summary: Invalid cache requests could record incompatible path semantics before strict model validation.
review_findings.resolution: All pure request fields are validated before touching a pin, and cache_kind is cross-checked against the nested artifact kind.

review_findings.summary: Default 64 KiB parsing and an arbitrary-path writer could leave unreadable or out-of-root sidecars.
review_findings.resolution: Reader and writer share a 1 MiB strict limit, validate before replacement, and writer publication requires GenerationPin plus a validated relative path.

review_findings.summary: Direct-CSV indicator helpers could mix the pin root with a different read/write root and under-bind the feature contract.
review_findings.resolution: Resolved roots must equal GenerationPin.data_root before access; physical cache namespaces are exact; effective defaults, algorithm source, normalizer source, and input mode are feature-bound.

review_findings.summary: Separate verify and parse operations permitted an ABA substitution between file reads.
review_findings.resolution: GenerationPin.read_verified_bytes returns bytes whose exact identity is checked, and pinned CSV/Parquet consumers parse only those in-memory bytes.

review_findings.summary: One PASS rereview began after the first T3 implementation commit and therefore did not cover the complete task diff.
review_findings.resolution: It was not counted as PASS; the final external review used the T3 ticket commit as its baseline and returned PASS with high confidence.
